purpose: Privacy-safe, room-by-room image-generation handoff for family space planning.
sharedConstraints: Use the source photo as the edit target, not only as style inspiration.
Remove existing movable furniture, rugs, wall decor, family photos and personal belongings.
Preserve the photographed architecture, camera angle, room proportions, walls, windows, doors, flooring, ceiling, fixed trim and natural-light direction.
Keep scale realistic and leave clear walking and emergency-exit paths.
Use only a few practical pieces, rounded edges, washable materials and anchored tall storage.
Use subtle Islamic-inspired arches or geometric patterns only. Do not generate Arabic, Qur'anic verses, sacred text or imitation calligraphy.
Do not include people, faces, names, addresses, family photographs, readable documents, logos, trademarks or watermarks.
Do not place bunk or loft beds beneath a ceiling fan.

If an aquarium is shown, use one lidded 10–20 gallon planted tank on a purpose-built stable stand, away from direct sunlight, with a safe cord drip loop and nearby GFCI protection.
